const _ATOM_LAYOUT_ELEMENT_SYMBOLS = Set{String}(split("H He Li Be B C N O F Ne Na Mg Al Si P S Cl Ar K Ca Sc Ti V Cr Mn Fe Co Ni Cu Zn Ga Ge As Se Br Kr Rb Sr Y Zr Nb Mo Tc Ru Rh Pd Ag Cd In Sn Sb Te I Xe Cs Ba La Ce Pr Nd Pm Sm Eu Gd Tb Dy Ho Er Tm Yb Lu Hf Ta W Re Os Ir Pt Au Hg Tl Pb Bi Po At Rn Fr Ra Ac Th Pa U Np Pu Am Cm Bk Cf Es Fm Md No Lr Rf Db Sg Bh Hs Mt Ds Rg Cn Nh Fl Mc Lv Ts Og D T"))

const _ATOM_LAYOUT_AMBIGUOUS_PREFIXES = Set{String}([
    "CA", "CD", "CE", "ND", "NE", "NH", "HE", "HF", "HG", "HO", "HS", "OG", "SG"
])

struct _AtomLayoutResidueData
    atom_names::Vector{String}
    atom_mask::Vector{Bool}
    elements::Vector{String}
end

function _atom_layout_is_text(value)::Bool
    return value isa AbstractString || value isa Symbol || value isa AbstractChar
end

function _atom_layout_lookup(container, key::AbstractString)
    container === nothing && return nothing

    if container isa AbstractDict
        haskey(container, key) && return container[key]
        symbol_key = Symbol(key)
        haskey(container, symbol_key) && return container[symbol_key]
        return nothing
    end

    symbol_key = Symbol(key)
    hasproperty(container, symbol_key) && return getproperty(container, symbol_key)

    if container isa AbstractArray || container isa AbstractString || container isa Tuple
        return nothing
    end

    if applicable(haskey, container, key) && haskey(container, key)
        return container[key]
    end

    if applicable(haskey, container, symbol_key) && haskey(container, symbol_key)
        return container[symbol_key]
    end

    return nothing
end

function _atom_layout_find(container, keys::Tuple)
    container === nothing && return nothing

    for key in keys
        value = _atom_layout_lookup(container, key)
        value !== nothing && return value
    end

    for wrapper in ("columns", "data")
        nested = _atom_layout_lookup(container, wrapper)

        if nested !== nothing && nested !== container
            for key in keys
                value = _atom_layout_lookup(nested, key)
                value !== nothing && return value
            end
        end
    end

    return nothing
end

function _atom_layout_ccd_component(ccd, residue_type::AbstractString)
    ccd === nothing && return nothing

    component = _atom_layout_lookup(ccd, residue_type)
    component !== nothing && return component

    for wrapper in (
        "components",
        "data",
        "entries",
        "ccd",
        "ccd_data",
        "residues",
        "atom_data",
        "atoms",
    )
        container = _atom_layout_lookup(ccd, wrapper)

        if container !== nothing && container !== ccd
            component = _atom_layout_lookup(container, residue_type)
            component !== nothing && return component
        end
    end

    return nothing
end

function _atom_layout_atom_name(
    value,
    context::AbstractString;
    allow_empty::Bool = false,
)::String
    _atom_layout_is_text(value) ||
        throw(ArgumentError("$context contains an atom name that is not textual"))

    atom_name = String(strip(string(value)))

    if isempty(atom_name)
        allow_empty && return atom_name
        throw(ArgumentError("$context contains an empty atom name"))
    end

    atom_name in (".", "?") &&
        throw(ArgumentError("$context contains an unspecified atom name"))

    return atom_name
end

function _atom_layout_element_symbol(value, context::AbstractString)::String
    _atom_layout_is_text(value) ||
        throw(ArgumentError("$context contains an element symbol that is not textual"))

    element = uppercasefirst(lowercase(String(strip(string(value)))))

    element in _ATOM_LAYOUT_ELEMENT_SYMBOLS ||
        throw(ArgumentError("$context contains an invalid element symbol: $(repr(value))"))

    return element
end

function _atom_layout_column_values(value, context::AbstractString)
    if value isa AbstractVector || value isa Tuple
        return value
    end

    _atom_layout_is_text(value) && return (value,)

    throw(ArgumentError("$context must be a vector, tuple, or textual scalar"))
end

function _atom_layout_ccd_atom_data(component, residue_type::AbstractString)
    context = "CCD component $residue_type"

    atom_name_keys = (
        "_chem_comp_atom.atom_id",
        "chem_comp_atom.atom_id",
        "atom_id",
        "atom_ids",
        "atom_names",
        "label_atom_id",
    )

    element_keys = (
        "_chem_comp_atom.type_symbol",
        "chem_comp_atom.type_symbol",
        "type_symbol",
        "elements",
        "element_symbols",
        "element",
    )

    atom_table = _atom_layout_find(
        component,
        ("_chem_comp_atom", "chem_comp_atom", "atoms", "atom_table"),
    )

    atom_table === nothing && (atom_table = component)

    atom_name_values = _atom_layout_find(component, atom_name_keys)
    element_values = _atom_layout_find(component, element_keys)

    if atom_table !== component
        if atom_name_values === nothing
            atom_name_values = _atom_layout_find(atom_table, atom_name_keys)
        end

        if element_values === nothing
            element_values = _atom_layout_find(atom_table, element_keys)
        end
    end

    if atom_name_values === nothing &&
       (atom_table isa AbstractVector || atom_table isa Tuple)
        if all(_atom_layout_is_text, atom_table)
            atom_name_values = atom_table
        else
            record_names = String[]
            record_elements = String[]
            found_element = false
            missing_element = false

            for atom_record in atom_table
                atom_name = _atom_layout_find(
                    atom_record,
                    ("atom_id", "atom_name", "name", "label_atom_id"),
                )

                atom_name === nothing &&
                    throw(ArgumentError("$context contains an atom record without an atom name"))

                push!(record_names, _atom_layout_atom_name(atom_name, context))

                if element_values === nothing
                    element = _atom_layout_find(
                        atom_record,
                        ("type_symbol", "element", "element_symbol"),
                    )

                    if element === nothing
                        missing_element = true
                    else
                        found_element = true
                        push!(record_elements, _atom_layout_element_symbol(element, context))
                    end
                end
            end

            if element_values === nothing
                if found_element && missing_element
                    throw(ArgumentError("$context contains incomplete per-atom element metadata"))
                end

                found_element && (element_values = record_elements)
            end

            atom_name_values = record_names
        end
    end

    atom_name_values === nothing &&
        throw(ArgumentError("$context does not expose chem_comp_atom atom identifiers"))

    raw_atom_names = _atom_layout_column_values(atom_name_values, "$context atom identifiers")
    atom_names = String[]
    sizehint!(atom_names, length(raw_atom_names))

    for value in raw_atom_names
        push!(atom_names, _atom_layout_atom_name(value, context))
    end

    length(Set(atom_names)) == length(atom_names) ||
        throw(ArgumentError("$context contains duplicate atom identifiers"))

    elements = nothing

    if element_values !== nothing
        raw_elements = _atom_layout_column_values(element_values, "$context element symbols")

        length(raw_elements) == length(atom_names) ||
            throw(DimensionMismatch("$context has $(length(atom_names)) atom identifiers but $(length(raw_elements)) element symbols"))

        elements = String[]
        sizehint!(elements, length(raw_elements))

        for value in raw_elements
            push!(elements, _atom_layout_element_symbol(value, context))
        end
    end

    return atom_names, elements
end

function first_element_char(
    atom_name::AbstractString;
    residue_type::Union{Nothing,AbstractString} = nothing,
)::String
    normalized_name = String(strip(atom_name))

    isempty(normalized_name) &&
        throw(ArgumentError("Cannot infer an element from an empty atom name"))

    character_index = firstindex(normalized_name)
    leading_digits = false

    while character_index <= lastindex(normalized_name) &&
          isdigit(normalized_name[character_index])
        leading_digits = true
        character_index = nextind(normalized_name, character_index)
    end

    character_index <= lastindex(normalized_name) ||
        throw(ArgumentError("Atom name $(repr(atom_name)) contains no element prefix"))

    first_letter = normalized_name[character_index]

    (isascii(first_letter) && isletter(first_letter)) ||
        throw(ArgumentError("Atom name $(repr(atom_name)) has an invalid element prefix"))

    single_letter_element = string(uppercase(first_letter))
    second_index = nextind(normalized_name, character_index)
    two_letter_element = nothing
    ambiguous_uppercase_prefix = false

    if second_index <= lastindex(normalized_name)
        second_letter = normalized_name[second_index]

        if isascii(second_letter) && isletter(second_letter)
            two_letter_element = string(uppercase(first_letter), lowercase(second_letter))

            ambiguous_uppercase_prefix =
                isuppercase(first_letter) &&
                isuppercase(second_letter) &&
                uppercase(two_letter_element) in _ATOM_LAYOUT_AMBIGUOUS_PREFIXES
        end
    end

    if residue_type !== nothing
        normalized_residue = String(strip(residue_type))
        residue_element = uppercasefirst(lowercase(normalized_residue))
        atom_suffix = SubString(normalized_name, character_index)

        if residue_element in _ATOM_LAYOUT_ELEMENT_SYMBOLS &&
           startswith(uppercase(atom_suffix), uppercase(normalized_residue))
            return residue_element
        end

        if haskey(STANDARD_ATOM_MASK, normalized_residue)
            two_letter_element == "Se" && return "Se"

            single_letter_element in _ATOM_LAYOUT_ELEMENT_SYMBOLS ||
                throw(ArgumentError("Cannot infer an element for atom $(repr(atom_name)) in residue $(repr(residue_type))"))

            return single_letter_element
        end
    end

    single_letter_alignment =
        length(atom_name) == 4 && isspace(first(atom_name))

    if !leading_digits &&
       !single_letter_alignment &&
       two_letter_element !== nothing &&
       two_letter_element in _ATOM_LAYOUT_ELEMENT_SYMBOLS &&
       !ambiguous_uppercase_prefix
        return two_letter_element
    end

    single_letter_element in _ATOM_LAYOUT_ELEMENT_SYMBOLS ||
        throw(ArgumentError("Cannot infer an element from atom name $(repr(atom_name))"))

    return single_letter_element
end

first_element_char(
    atom_name::AbstractString,
    residue_type::AbstractString,
)::String = first_element_char(atom_name; residue_type = residue_type)

function _atom_layout_residue_data(
    residue_type::AbstractString,
    ccd = nothing,
)::_AtomLayoutResidueData
    normalized_res_type = String(residue_type)
    atom_order = get(ATOM_ORDER, normalized_res_type, nothing)
    standard_mask = get(STANDARD_ATOM_MASK, normalized_res_type, nothing)
    ccd_atom_names = nothing
    ccd_elements = nothing

    if ccd !== nothing
        component = _atom_layout_ccd_component(ccd, normalized_res_type)

        if component !== nothing
            ccd_atom_names, ccd_elements =
                _atom_layout_ccd_atom_data(component, normalized_res_type)
        end
    end

    atom_names = fill("", NUM_ATOM_SLOTS)
    atom_mask = fill(false, NUM_ATOM_SLOTS)
    elements = fill("", NUM_ATOM_SLOTS)

    if atom_order === nothing
        standard_mask === nothing ||
            throw(ArgumentError("STANDARD_ATOM_MASK defines residue $(repr(normalized_res_type)), but ATOM_ORDER does not"))

        ccd_atom_names === nothing &&
            throw(ArgumentError("No atom order is available for residue $(repr(normalized_res_type)); provide its CCD atom data"))

        length(ccd_atom_names) <= NUM_ATOM_SLOTS ||
            throw(DimensionMismatch("Residue $(repr(normalized_res_type)) has $(length(ccd_atom_names)) atoms, exceeding NUM_ATOM_SLOTS=$NUM_ATOM_SLOTS"))

        for (slot_index, atom_name) in enumerate(ccd_atom_names)
            atom_names[slot_index] = atom_name
            atom_mask[slot_index] = true
        end
    else
        for (slot_index, value) in enumerate(atom_order)
            atom_name = _atom_layout_atom_name(
                value,
                "ATOM_ORDER entry for residue $(repr(normalized_res_type))";
                allow_empty = true,
            )

            if slot_index > NUM_ATOM_SLOTS
                isempty(atom_name) ||
                    throw(DimensionMismatch("ATOM_ORDER for residue $(repr(normalized_res_type)) exceeds NUM_ATOM_SLOTS=$NUM_ATOM_SLOTS"))

                continue
            end

            atom_names[slot_index] = atom_name
        end

        if standard_mask === nothing
            for slot_index in 1:NUM_ATOM_SLOTS
                atom_mask[slot_index] = !isempty(atom_names[slot_index])
            end
        else
            for (slot_index, value) in enumerate(standard_mask)
                present = Bool(value)

                if slot_index > NUM_ATOM_SLOTS
                    present &&
                        throw(DimensionMismatch("STANDARD_ATOM_MASK for residue $(repr(normalized_res_type)) exceeds NUM_ATOM_SLOTS=$NUM_ATOM_SLOTS"))

                    continue
                end

                if present && isempty(atom_names[slot_index])
                    throw(ArgumentError("STANDARD_ATOM_MASK selects unnamed slot $slot_index for residue $(repr(normalized_res_type))"))
                end

                atom_mask[slot_index] = present
            end
        end
    end

    seen_atom_names = Set{String}()

    for atom_name in atom_names
        isempty(atom_name) && continue

        atom_name in seen_atom_names &&
            throw(ArgumentError("Atom order for residue $(repr(normalized_res_type)) contains duplicate atom name $(repr(atom_name))"))

        push!(seen_atom_names, atom_name)
    end

    ccd_element_lookup = Dict{String,String}()

    if ccd_elements !== nothing
        for (atom_name, element) in zip(ccd_atom_names, ccd_elements)
            ccd_element_lookup[atom_name] = element
        end
    end

    for slot_index in 1:NUM_ATOM_SLOTS
        atom_mask[slot_index] || continue

        atom_name = atom_names[slot_index]
        element = get(ccd_element_lookup, atom_name, nothing)

        if element !== nothing
            elements[slot_index] = element
        else
            elements[slot_index] = first_element_char(
                atom_name;
                residue_type = normalized_res_type,
            )
        end
    end

    return _AtomLayoutResidueData(atom_names, atom_mask, elements)
end

function _atom_layout_validate_dense_arrays(
    positions::AbstractArray{<:Real,3},
    mask::AbstractMatrix{Bool},
)::Tuple{Int,Int}
    Base.require_one_based_indexing(positions, mask)

    size(positions, 3) == 3 ||
        throw(DimensionMismatch("positions must have exactly three coordinate columns; received shape $(size(positions))"))

    number_of_tokens = size(positions, 1)
    number_of_slots = size(positions, 2)

    size(mask) == (number_of_tokens, number_of_slots) ||
        throw(DimensionMismatch("positions shape $(size(positions)) is incompatible with mask shape $(size(mask))"))

    return number_of_tokens, number_of_slots
end

function _atom_layout_validate_tokens(
    token_residue_types::AbstractVector{<:AbstractString},
    token_chain_ids::AbstractVector{<:AbstractString},
    token_seq_ids::AbstractVector{<:AbstractString},
)::Int
    Base.require_one_based_indexing(
        token_residue_types,
        token_chain_ids,
        token_seq_ids,
    )

    number_of_tokens = length(token_residue_types)

    length(token_chain_ids) == number_of_tokens ||
        throw(DimensionMismatch("token_chain_ids has $(length(token_chain_ids)) entries, but token_residue_types has $number_of_tokens"))

    length(token_seq_ids) == number_of_tokens ||
        throw(DimensionMismatch("token_seq_ids has $(length(token_seq_ids)) entries, but token_residue_types has $number_of_tokens"))

    return number_of_tokens
end

function _atom_layout_structure_identifier(
    value,
    column_name::Symbol,
    row_index::Integer,
)::String
    if value === nothing || ismissing(value)
        throw(ArgumentError("Structure column $column_name has a missing identifier at atom $row_index"))
    end

    return string(value)
end

function _atom_layout_structure_coordinate(
    value,
    column_name::Symbol,
    row_index::Integer,
)::Float32
    coordinate = if value isa Real
        Float32(value)
    elseif value isa AbstractString
        parsed = tryparse(Float32, strip(value))

        parsed === nothing &&
            throw(ArgumentError("Structure column $column_name has an invalid coordinate at atom $row_index: $(repr(value))"))

        parsed
    else
        throw(ArgumentError("Structure column $column_name has a nonnumeric coordinate at atom $row_index"))
    end

    isfinite(coordinate) ||
        throw(ArgumentError("Structure column $column_name has a nonfinite Float32 coordinate at atom $row_index"))

    return coordinate
end

function atom_layout_to_flat(
    positions::AbstractArray{<:Real,3},
    mask::AbstractMatrix{Bool},
)::Tuple{Matrix{Float32},Vector{Bool}}
    number_of_tokens, number_of_slots =
        _atom_layout_validate_dense_arrays(positions, mask)

    number_of_atoms = count(mask)
    flat_positions = Matrix{Float32}(undef, number_of_atoms, 3)
    flat_mask = fill(true, number_of_atoms)
    atom_index = 0

    @inbounds for token_index in 1:number_of_tokens
        for slot_index in 1:number_of_slots
            mask[token_index, slot_index] || continue

            atom_index += 1
            flat_positions[atom_index, 1] = Float32(positions[token_index, slot_index, 1])
            flat_positions[atom_index, 2] = Float32(positions[token_index, slot_index, 2])
            flat_positions[atom_index, 3] = Float32(positions[token_index, slot_index, 3])
        end
    end

    return flat_positions, flat_mask
end

function flat_to_atom_layout(
    flat_positions::AbstractMatrix{<:Real},
    token_atom_counts::AbstractVector{<:Integer},
)::Array{Float32,3}
    Base.require_one_based_indexing(flat_positions, token_atom_counts)

    size(flat_positions, 2) == 3 ||
        throw(DimensionMismatch("flat_positions must have exactly three columns; received shape $(size(flat_positions))"))

    number_of_tokens = length(token_atom_counts)
    remaining_atoms = size(flat_positions, 1)
    maximum_atoms = 0

    for (token_index, atom_count) in enumerate(token_atom_counts)
        atom_count >= 0 ||
            throw(ArgumentError("token_atom_counts[$token_index] must be nonnegative"))

        atom_count <= remaining_atoms ||
            throw(DimensionMismatch("token_atom_counts requires more atoms than the $(size(flat_positions, 1)) rows in flat_positions"))

        remaining_atoms -= atom_count
        maximum_atoms = max(maximum_atoms, atom_count)
    end

    remaining_atoms == 0 ||
        throw(DimensionMismatch("flat_positions contains $remaining_atoms rows not accounted for by token_atom_counts"))

    dense_positions = zeros(Float32, number_of_tokens, maximum_atoms, 3)
    atom_index = 0

    @inbounds for token_index in 1:number_of_tokens
        for slot_index in 1:token_atom_counts[token_index]
            atom_index += 1
            dense_positions[token_index, slot_index, 1] = Float32(flat_positions[atom_index, 1])
            dense_positions[token_index, slot_index, 2] = Float32(flat_positions[atom_index, 2])
            dense_positions[token_index, slot_index, 3] = Float32(flat_positions[atom_index, 3])
        end
    end

    return dense_positions
end

function flat_to_atom_layout(
    flat_positions::AbstractMatrix{<:Real},
    mask::AbstractMatrix{Bool},
)::Array{Float32,3}
    Base.require_one_based_indexing(flat_positions, mask)

    size(flat_positions, 2) == 3 ||
        throw(DimensionMismatch("flat_positions must have exactly three columns; received shape $(size(flat_positions))"))

    number_of_atoms = count(mask)

    size(flat_positions, 1) == number_of_atoms ||
        throw(DimensionMismatch("flat_positions has $(size(flat_positions, 1)) rows, but mask selects $number_of_atoms atoms"))

    number_of_tokens, number_of_slots = size(mask)
    dense_positions = zeros(Float32, number_of_tokens, number_of_slots, 3)
    atom_index = 0

    @inbounds for token_index in 1:number_of_tokens
        for slot_index in 1:number_of_slots
            mask[token_index, slot_index] || continue

            atom_index += 1
            dense_positions[token_index, slot_index, 1] = Float32(flat_positions[atom_index, 1])
            dense_positions[token_index, slot_index, 2] = Float32(flat_positions[atom_index, 2])
            dense_positions[token_index, slot_index, 3] = Float32(flat_positions[atom_index, 3])
        end
    end

    return dense_positions
end

function get_token_atom_mask(
    token_residue_types::AbstractVector{<:AbstractString},
    ccd = nothing,
)::Matrix{Bool}
    Base.require_one_based_indexing(token_residue_types)

    number_of_tokens = length(token_residue_types)
    mask = fill(false, number_of_tokens, NUM_ATOM_SLOTS)
    residue_cache = Dict{String,_AtomLayoutResidueData}()

    for (token_index, residue_value) in enumerate(token_residue_types)
        residue_type = String(residue_value)

        residue_data = get!(residue_cache, residue_type) do
            _atom_layout_residue_data(residue_type, ccd)
        end

        for slot_index in 1:NUM_ATOM_SLOTS
            mask[token_index, slot_index] = residue_data.atom_mask[slot_index]
        end
    end

    return mask
end

function dense_positions_from_structure(
    s::Structure,
    token_residue_types::AbstractVector{<:AbstractString},
    token_chain_ids::AbstractVector{<:AbstractString},
    token_seq_ids::AbstractVector{<:AbstractString};
    ccd = nothing,
)::Tuple{Array{Float32,3},Matrix{Bool}}
    number_of_tokens = _atom_layout_validate_tokens(
        token_residue_types,
        token_chain_ids,
        token_seq_ids,
    )

    positions = zeros(Float32, number_of_tokens, NUM_ATOM_SLOTS, 3)
    mask = fill(false, number_of_tokens, NUM_ATOM_SLOTS)
    number_of_structure_atoms = num_atoms(s)

    number_of_structure_atoms >= 0 ||
        throw(ArgumentError("Structure reports a negative atom count"))

    if number_of_tokens == 0 || number_of_structure_atoms == 0
        return positions, mask
    end

    structure_chain_ids = get_column(s.atoms, :label_asym_id)
    structure_seq_ids = get_column(s.atoms, :label_seq_id)
    structure_atom_names = get_column(s.atoms, :label_atom_id)
    structure_x_coordinates = get_column(s.atoms, :Cartn_x)
    structure_y_coordinates = get_column(s.atoms, :Cartn_y)
    structure_z_coordinates = get_column(s.atoms, :Cartn_z)

    for (column_name, column) in (
        (:label_asym_id, structure_chain_ids),
        (:label_seq_id, structure_seq_ids),
        (:label_atom_id, structure_atom_names),
        (:Cartn_x, structure_x_coordinates),
        (:Cartn_y, structure_y_coordinates),
        (:Cartn_z, structure_z_coordinates),
    )
        Base.require_one_based_indexing(column)

        length(column) == number_of_structure_atoms ||
            throw(DimensionMismatch("Structure column $column_name has $(length(column)) entries, but the structure reports $number_of_structure_atoms atoms"))
    end

    atom_index = Dict{
        Tuple{String,String,String},
        Tuple{Float32,Float32,Float32},
    }()

    for structure_atom_index in 1:number_of_structure_atoms
        chain_id = _atom_layout_structure_identifier(
            structure_chain_ids[structure_atom_index],
            :label_asym_id,
            structure_atom_index,
        )

        sequence_id = _atom_layout_structure_identifier(
            structure_seq_ids[structure_atom_index],
            :label_seq_id,
            structure_atom_index,
        )

        atom_name = _atom_layout_atom_name(
            structure_atom_names[structure_atom_index],
            "Structure atom identifiers",
        )

        position = (
            _atom_layout_structure_coordinate(
                structure_x_coordinates[structure_atom_index],
                :Cartn_x,

function build_structure_from_dense_positions(;
    positions::AbstractArray{<:Real,3},
    mask::AbstractMatrix{Bool},
    token_residue_types::AbstractVector{<:AbstractString},
    token_chain_ids::AbstractVector{<:AbstractString},
    token_seq_ids::AbstractVector{<:AbstractString},
    bfactors::AbstractVector{<:Real},
    name::AbstractString = "predicted",
    ccd = nothing,
)::Structure
    number_of_position_tokens, number_of_slots =
        _atom_layout_validate_dense_arrays(positions, mask)

    number_of_tokens = _atom_layout_validate_tokens(
        token_residue_types,
        token_chain_ids,
        token_seq_ids,
    )

    Base.require_one_based_indexing(bfactors)

    number_of_position_tokens == number_of_tokens ||
        throw(DimensionMismatch("positions contains $number_of_position_tokens tokens, but token metadata contains $number_of_tokens"))

    number_of_slots <= NUM_ATOM_SLOTS ||
        throw(DimensionMismatch("positions contains $number_of_slots atom slots, exceeding NUM_ATOM_SLOTS=$NUM_ATOM_SLOTS"))

    length(bfactors) == number_of_tokens ||
        throw(DimensionMismatch("bfactors has $(length(bfactors)) entries, but token metadata contains $number_of_tokens"))

    all(isfinite, bfactors) ||
        throw(ArgumentError("bfactors must contain only finite values"))

    number_of_atoms = count(mask)

    if number_of_atoms == 0
        return Structure(
            String(name),
            StructureTable(),
            ChainInfo[],
            ResidueInfo[],
            Bond[],
        )
    end

    all_chain_ids = Vector{String}(undef, number_of_atoms)
    all_residue_ids = Vector{String}(undef, number_of_atoms)
    all_component_ids = Vector{String}(undef, number_of_atoms)
    all_atom_names = Vector{String}(undef, number_of_atoms)
    all_elements = Vector{String}(undef, number_of_atoms)
    all_positions = Matrix{Float32}(undef, number_of_atoms, 3)
    all_bfactors = Vector{Float32}(undef, number_of_atoms)
    residue_cache = Dict{String,_AtomLayoutResidueData}()
    atom_index = 0

    for token_index in 1:number_of_tokens
        any(view(mask, token_index, :)) || continue

        residue_type = String(token_residue_types[token_index])
        chain_id = String(token_chain_ids[token_index])
        sequence_id = String(token_seq_ids[token_index])
        bfactor_value = Float32(bfactors[token_index])

        residue_data = get!(residue_cache, residue_type) do
            _atom_layout_residue_data(residue_type, ccd)
        end

        for slot_index in 1:number_of_slots
            mask[token_index, slot_index] || continue

            residue_data.atom_mask[slot_index] ||
                throw(ArgumentError("mask selects invalid atom slot $slot_index for token $token_index with residue type $(repr(residue_type))"))

            atom_name = residue_data.atom_names[slot_index]
            element = residue_data.elements[slot_index]

            isempty(atom_name) &&
                throw(ArgumentError("mask selects an unnamed atom slot for token $token_index"))

            isempty(element) &&
                throw(ArgumentError("Element metadata is unavailable for atom $(repr(atom_name)) in residue $(repr(residue_type)); provide complete CCD element symbols"))

            x_coordinate = Float32(positions[token_index, slot_index, 1])
            y_coordinate = Float32(positions[token_index, slot_index, 2])
            z_coordinate = Float32(positions[token_index, slot_index, 3])

            if !(isfinite(x_coordinate) &&
                 isfinite(y_coordinate) &&
                 isfinite(z_coordinate))
                throw(ArgumentError("positions contains nonfinite coordinates for token $token_index at atom slot $slot_index"))
            end

            atom_index += 1
            all_chain_ids[atom_index] = chain_id
            all_residue_ids[atom_index] = sequence_id
            all_component_ids[atom_index] = residue_type
            all_atom_names[atom_index] = atom_name
            all_elements[atom_index] = element
            all_positions[atom_index, 1] = x_coordinate
            all_positions[atom_index, 2] = y_coordinate
            all_positions[atom_index, 3] = z_coordinate
            all_bfactors[atom_index] = bfactor_value
        end
    end

    return structure_from_arrays(;
        name = String(name),
        chain_ids = all_chain_ids,
        res_ids = all_residue_ids,
        comp_ids = all_component_ids,
        atom_names = all_atom_names,
        elements = all_elements,
        positions = all_positions,
        bfactors = all_bfactors,
    )
end

struct _AtomLayoutResidueData

function _atom_layout_is_text(value)::Bool
    return value isa AbstractString || value isa Symbol || value isa AbstractChar
end

function _atom_layout_lookup(container, key::AbstractString)
    container === nothing && return nothing

    if container isa AbstractDict
        haskey(container, key) && return container[key]
        symbol_key = Symbol(key)
        haskey(container, symbol_key) && return container[symbol_key]
        return nothing
    end

    symbol_key = Symbol(key)
    hasproperty(container, symbol_key) && return getproperty(container, symbol_key)

    end

        return container[key]
    end

    if applicable(haskey, container, symbol_key) && haskey(container, symbol_key)
        return container[symbol_key]
    end

    return nothing
end

function _atom_layout_find(container, keys::Tuple)
    container === nothing && return nothing

    for key in keys
        value = _atom_layout_lookup(container, key)
        value !== nothing && return value
    end

    for wrapper in ("columns", "data")
        nested = _atom_layout_lookup(container, wrapper)

        if nested !== nothing && nested !== container
            for key in keys
                value = _atom_layout_lookup(nested, key)
                value !== nothing && return value
            end
        end
    end

    return nothing
end

function _atom_layout_ccd_component(ccd, residue_type::AbstractString)
    ccd === nothing && return nothing

    component = _atom_layout_lookup(ccd, residue_type)
    component !== nothing && return component

    for wrapper in (
        "components",
        "data",
        "entries",
        "ccd",
        "ccd_data",
        "residues",
        "atom_data",
        "atoms",
    )
        container = _atom_layout_lookup(ccd, wrapper)

        if container !== nothing && container !== ccd
            component = _atom_layout_lookup(container, residue_type)
            component !== nothing && return component
        end
    end

end

function _atom_layout_atom_name(
    value,
    context::AbstractString;
    allow_empty::Bool = false,
)::String
    _atom_layout_is_text(value) ||
        throw(ArgumentError("$context contains an atom name that is not textual"))

    atom_name = String(strip(string(value)))

    if isempty(atom_name)
        allow_empty && return atom_name
        throw(ArgumentError("$context contains an empty atom name"))
    end

    atom_name in (".", "?") &&
        throw(ArgumentError("$context contains an unspecified atom name"))

    return atom_name
end

function _atom_layout_element_symbol(value, context::AbstractString)::String
    _atom_layout_is_text(value) ||
        throw(ArgumentError("$context contains an element symbol that is not textual"))

    element = uppercasefirst(lowercase(String(strip(string(value)))))

    element in _ATOM_LAYOUT_ELEMENT_SYMBOLS ||
        throw(ArgumentError("$context contains an invalid element symbol: $(repr(value))"))

    return element
end

function _atom_layout_column_values(value, context::AbstractString)

function first_element_char(
    atom_name::AbstractString;
    residue_type::Union{Nothing,AbstractString} = nothing,
)::String
    normalized_name = String(strip(atom_name))

    isempty(normalized_name) &&
        throw(ArgumentError("Cannot infer an element from an empty atom name"))

    character_index = firstindex(normalized_name)
    leading_digits = false

    while character_index <= lastindex(normalized_name) &&
          isdigit(normalized_name[character_index])
        leading_digits = true
        character_index = nextind(normalized_name, character_index)
    end

    character_index <= lastindex(normalized_name) ||
        throw(ArgumentError("Atom name $(repr(atom_name)) contains no element prefix"))

    first_letter = normalized_name[character_index]

    (isascii(first_letter) && isletter(first_letter)) ||
        throw(ArgumentError("Atom name $(repr(atom_name)) has an invalid element prefix"))

    single_letter_element = string(uppercase(first_letter))
    second_index = nextind(normalized_name, character_index)
    two_letter_element = nothing
    ambiguous_uppercase_prefix = false

    if second_index <= lastindex(normalized_name)
        second_letter = normalized_name[second_index]

        if isascii(second_letter) && isletter(second_letter)
            two_letter_element = string(uppercase(first_letter), lowercase(second_letter))

            ambiguous_uppercase_prefix =
                isuppercase(first_letter) &&
                isuppercase(second_letter) &&
                uppercase(two_letter_element) in _ATOM_LAYOUT_AMBIGUOUS_PREFIXES
        end
    end

    if residue_type !== nothing
        normalized_residue = String(strip(residue_type))
        residue_element = uppercasefirst(lowercase(normalized_residue))
        atom_suffix = SubString(normalized_name, character_index)

        if residue_element in _ATOM_LAYOUT_ELEMENT_SYMBOLS &&
           startswith(uppercase(atom_suffix), uppercase(normalized_residue))
            return residue_element
        end

        if haskey(STANDARD_ATOM_MASK, normalized_residue)
            two_letter_element == "Se" && return "Se"

            single_letter_element in _ATOM_LAYOUT_ELEMENT_SYMBOLS ||
                throw(ArgumentError("Cannot infer an element for atom $(repr(atom_name)) in residue $(repr(residue_type))"))

            return single_letter_element
        end
    end

    single_letter_alignment =
        length(atom_name) == 4 && isspace(first(atom_name))

    if !leading_digits &&
       !single_letter_alignment &&
       two_letter_element !== nothing &&
       two_letter_element in _ATOM_LAYOUT_ELEMENT_SYMBOLS &&
       !ambiguous_uppercase_prefix
        return two_letter_element
    end

    single_letter_element in _ATOM_LAYOUT_ELEMENT_SYMBOLS ||
        throw(ArgumentError("Cannot infer an element from atom name $(repr(atom_name))"))

    return single_letter_element
end

first_element_char(
    atom_name::AbstractString,
    residue_type::AbstractString,
)::String = first_element_char(atom_name; residue_type = residue_type)

function _atom_layout_residue_data(
    residue_type::AbstractString,
    ccd = nothing,
)::_AtomLayoutResidueData
    normalized_res_type = String(residue_type)
    atom_order = get(ATOM_ORDER, normalized_res_type, nothing)
    standard_mask = get(STANDARD_ATOM_MASK, normalized_res_type, nothing)
    ccd_atom_names = nothing
    ccd_elements = nothing

    if ccd !== nothing
        component = _atom_layout_ccd_component(ccd, normalized_res_type)

        if component !== nothing
            ccd_atom_names, ccd_elements =
                _atom_layout_ccd_atom_data(component, normalized_res_type)
        end
    end

    atom_names = fill("", NUM_ATOM_SLOTS)
    atom_mask = fill(false, NUM_ATOM_SLOTS)
    elements = fill("", NUM_ATOM_SLOTS)

    if atom_order === nothing
        standard_mask === nothing ||
            throw(ArgumentError("STANDARD_ATOM_MASK defines residue $(repr(normalized_res_type)), but ATOM_ORDER does not"))

        ccd_atom_names === nothing &&
            throw(ArgumentError("No atom order is available for residue $(repr(normalized_res_type)); provide its CCD atom data"))

        length(ccd_atom_names) <= NUM_ATOM_SLOTS ||
            throw(DimensionMismatch("Residue $(repr(normalized_res_type)) has $(length(ccd_atom_names)) atoms, exceeding NUM_ATOM_SLOTS=$NUM_ATOM_SLOTS"))

        for (slot_index, atom_name) in enumerate(ccd_atom_names)
            atom_names[slot_index] = atom_name
            atom_mask[slot_index] = true
        end
    else
        for (slot_index, value) in enumerate(atom_order)
            atom_name = _atom_layout_atom_name(
                value,
                "ATOM_ORDER entry for residue $(repr(normalized_res_type))";
                allow_empty = true,
            )

            if slot_index > NUM_ATOM_SLOTS
                isempty(atom_name) ||
                    throw(DimensionMismatch("ATOM_ORDER for residue $(repr(normalized_res_type)) exceeds NUM_ATOM_SLOTS=$NUM_ATOM_SLOTS"))

                continue
            end

            atom_names[slot_index] = atom_name
        end

        if standard_mask === nothing
            for slot_index in 1:NUM_ATOM_SLOTS
                atom_mask[slot_index] = !isempty(atom_names[slot_index])
            end
        else
            for (slot_index, value) in enumerate(standard_mask)
                present = Bool(value)

                if slot_index > NUM_ATOM_SLOTS
                    present &&
                        throw(DimensionMismatch("STANDARD_ATOM_MASK for residue $(repr(normalized_res_type)) exceeds NUM_ATOM_SLOTS=$NUM_ATOM_SLOTS"))

                    continue
                end

                if present && isempty(atom_names[slot_index])
                    throw(ArgumentError("STANDARD_ATOM_MASK selects unnamed slot $slot_index for residue $(repr(normalized_res_type))"))
                end

                atom_mask[slot_index] = present
            end
        end
    end

    seen_atom_names = Set{String}()

    for atom_name in atom_names
        isempty(atom_name) && continue

        atom_name in seen_atom_names &&
            throw(ArgumentError("Atom order for residue $(repr(normalized_res_type)) contains duplicate atom name $(repr(atom_name))"))

        push!(seen_atom_names, atom_name)
    end

    ccd_element_lookup = Dict{String,String}()

    if ccd_elements !== nothing
        for (atom_name, element) in zip(ccd_atom_names, ccd_elements)
            ccd_element_lookup[atom_name] = element
        end
    end

    for slot_index in 1:NUM_ATOM_SLOTS
        atom_mask[slot_index] || continue

        atom_name = atom_names[slot_index]
        element = get(ccd_element_lookup, atom_name, nothing)

        if element !== nothing
            elements[slot_index] = element
        else
            elements[slot_index] = first_element_char(
                atom_name;
                residue_type = normalized_res_type,
            )
        end
    end

    return _AtomLayoutResidueData(atom_names, atom_mask, elements)
end

function _atom_layout_validate_dense_arrays(
    positions::AbstractArray{<:Real,3},
    mask::AbstractMatrix{Bool},
)::Tuple{Int,Int}
    Base.require_one_based_indexing(positions, mask)

    size(positions, 3) == 3 ||
        throw(DimensionMismatch("positions must have exactly three coordinate columns; received shape $(size(positions))"))

    number_of_tokens = size(positions, 1)
    number_of_slots = size(positions, 2)

    size(mask) == (number_of_tokens, number_of_slots) ||
        throw(DimensionMismatch("positions shape $(size(positions)) is incompatible with mask shape $(size(mask))"))

    return number_of_tokens, number_of_slots
end

function _atom_layout_validate_tokens(
    token_residue_types::AbstractVector{<:AbstractString},
    token_chain_ids::AbstractVector{<:AbstractString},
    token_seq_ids::AbstractVector{<:AbstractString},
)::Int
    Base.require_one_based_indexing(
        token_residue_types,
        token_chain_ids,
        token_seq_ids,
    )

    number_of_tokens = length(token_residue_types)

    length(token_chain_ids) == number_of_tokens ||
        throw(DimensionMismatch("token_chain_ids has $(length(token_chain_ids)) entries, but token_residue_types has $number_of_tokens"))

    length(token_seq_ids) == number_of_tokens ||
        throw(DimensionMismatch("token_seq_ids has $(length(token_seq_ids)) entries, but token_residue_types has $number_of_tokens"))

    return number_of_tokens
end

function _atom_layout_structure_identifier(
    value,
    column_name::Symbol,
    row_index::Integer,
)::String
    if value === nothing || ismissing(value)
        throw(ArgumentError("Structure column $column_name has a missing identifier at atom $row_index"))
    end

    return string(value)
end

function _atom_layout_structure_coordinate(
    value,
    column_name::Symbol,
    row_index::Integer,
)::Float32
    coordinate = if value isa Real
        Float32(value)
    elseif value isa AbstractString
        parsed = tryparse(Float32, strip(value))

        parsed === nothing &&
            throw(ArgumentError("Structure column $column_name has an invalid coordinate at atom $row_index: $(repr(value))"))

        parsed
    else
        throw(ArgumentError("Structure column $column_name has a nonnumeric coordinate at atom $row_index"))
    end

    isfinite(coordinate) ||
        throw(ArgumentError("Structure column $column_name has a nonfinite Float32 coordinate at atom $row_index"))

    return coordinate
end

function atom_layout_to_flat(
    positions::AbstractArray{<:Real,3},
    mask::AbstractMatrix{Bool},
)::Tuple{Matrix{Float32},Vector{Bool}}
    number_of_tokens, number_of_slots =
        _atom_layout_validate_dense_arrays(positions, mask)

    number_of_atoms = count(mask)
    flat_positions = Matrix{Float32}(undef, number_of_atoms, 3)
    flat_mask = fill(true, number_of_atoms)
    atom_index = 0

    @inbounds for token_index in 1:number_of_tokens
        for slot_index in 1:number_of_slots
            mask[token_index, slot_index] || continue

            atom_index += 1
            flat_positions[atom_index, 1] = Float32(positions[token_index, slot_index, 1])
            flat_positions[atom_index, 2] = Float32(positions[token_index, slot_index, 2])
            flat_positions[atom_index, 3] = Float32(positions[token_index, slot_index, 3])

    return flat_positions, flat_mask

function flat_to_atom_layout(
    flat_positions::AbstractMatrix{<:Real},
    token_atom_counts::AbstractVector{<:Integer},
)::Array{Float32,3}
    Base.require_one_based_indexing(flat_positions, token_atom_counts)

    size(flat_positions, 2) == 3 ||
        throw(DimensionMismatch("flat_positions must have exactly three columns; received shape $(size(flat_positions))"))

    number_of_tokens = length(token_atom_counts)
    remaining_atoms = size(flat_positions, 1)
    maximum_atoms = 0

    for (token_index, atom_count) in enumerate(token_atom_counts)
        atom_count >= 0 ||
            throw(ArgumentError("token_atom_counts[$token_index] must be nonnegative"))

        atom_count <= remaining_atoms ||
            throw(DimensionMismatch("token_atom_counts requires more atoms than the $(size(flat_positions, 1)) rows in flat_positions"))

        remaining_atoms -= atom_count
        maximum_atoms = max(maximum_atoms, atom_count)
    end

    remaining_atoms == 0 ||
        throw(DimensionMismatch("flat_positions contains $remaining_atoms rows not accounted for by token_atom_counts"))

    dense_positions = zeros(Float32, number_of_tokens, maximum_atoms, 3)
    atom_index = 0

    @inbounds for token_index in 1:number_of_tokens
        for slot_index in 1:token_atom_counts[token_index]
            atom_index += 1
            dense_positions[token_index, slot_index, 1] = Float32(flat_positions[atom_index, 1])
            dense_positions[token_index, slot_index, 2] = Float32(flat_positions[atom_index, 2])
            dense_positions[token_index, slot_index, 3] = Float32(flat_positions[atom_index, 3])
        end
    end

    return dense_positions
end

function flat_to_atom_layout(
    flat_positions::AbstractMatrix{<:Real},
    mask::AbstractMatrix{Bool},
)::Array{Float32,3}
    Base.require_one_based_indexing(flat_positions, mask)

    size(flat_positions, 2) == 3 ||
        throw(DimensionMismatch("flat_positions must have exactly three columns; received shape $(size(flat_positions))"))

    number_of_atoms = count(mask)

    size(flat_positions, 1) == number_of_atoms ||
        throw(DimensionMismatch("flat_positions has $(size(flat_positions, 1)) rows, but mask selects $number_of_atoms atoms"))

    number_of_tokens, number_of_slots = size(mask)
    dense_positions = zeros(Float32, number_of_tokens, number_of_slots, 3)
    atom_index = 0

    @inbounds for token_index in 1:number_of_tokens
        for slot_index in 1:number_of_slots
            mask[token_index, slot_index] || continue

            atom_index += 1
            dense_positions[token_index, slot_index, 1] = Float32(flat_positions[atom_index, 1])
            dense_positions[token_index, slot_index, 2] = Float32(flat_positions[atom_index, 2])
            dense_positions[token_index, slot_index, 3] = Float32(flat_positions[atom_index, 3])
        end
    end

    return dense_positions
end

function get_token_atom_mask(
    token_residue_types::AbstractVector{<:AbstractString},
    ccd = nothing,
)::Matrix{Bool}
    Base.require_one_based_indexing(token_residue_types)

    number_of_tokens = length(token_residue_types)
    mask = fill(false, number_of_tokens, NUM_ATOM_SLOTS)
    residue_cache = Dict{String,_AtomLayoutResidueData}()

    for (token_index, residue_value) in enumerate(token_residue_types)
        residue_type = String(residue_value)

        residue_data = get!(residue_cache, residue_type) do
            _atom_layout_residue_data(residue_type, ccd)
        end

        for slot_index in 1:NUM_ATOM_SLOTS
            mask[token_index, slot_index] = residue_data.atom_mask[slot_index]
        end
    end

    return mask
end

function dense_positions_from_structure(
    s::Structure,
    token_residue_types::AbstractVector{<:AbstractString},
    token_chain_ids::AbstractVector{<:AbstractString},
    token_seq_ids::AbstractVector{<:AbstractString};
    ccd = nothing,
)::Tuple{Array{Float32,3},Matrix{Bool}}
    number_of_tokens = _atom_layout_validate_tokens(
        token_residue_types,
        token_chain_ids,
        token_seq_ids,
    )

    positions = zeros(Float32, number_of_tokens, NUM_ATOM_SLOTS, 3)
    mask = fill(false, number_of_tokens, NUM_ATOM_SLOTS)
    number_of_structure_atoms = num_atoms(s)

    number_of_structure_atoms >= 0 ||
        throw(ArgumentError("Structure reports a negative atom count"))

    if number_of_tokens == 0 || number_of_structure_atoms == 0
        return positions, mask
    end

    structure_chain_ids = get_column(s.atoms, :label_asym_id)
    structure_seq_ids = get_column(s.atoms, :label_seq_id)
    structure_atom_names = get_column(s.atoms, :label_atom_id)
    structure_x_coordinates = get_column(s.atoms, :Cartn_x)
    structure_y_coordinates = get_column(s.atoms, :Cartn_y)
    structure_z_coordinates = get_column(s.atoms, :Cartn_z)

    for (column_name, column) in (
        (:label_asym_id, structure_chain_ids),
        (:label_seq_id, structure_seq_ids),
        (:label_atom_id, structure_atom_names),
        (:Cartn_x, structure_x_coordinates),
        (:Cartn_y, structure_y_coordinates),
        (:Cartn_z, structure_z_coordinates),
    )
        Base.require_one_based_indexing(column)

        length(column) == number_of_structure_atoms ||
            throw(DimensionMismatch("Structure column $column_name has $(length(column)) entries, but the structure reports $number_of_structure_atoms atoms"))
    end

    atom_index = Dict{
        Tuple{String,String,String},
        Tuple{Float32,Float32,Float32},
    }()

    for structure_atom_index in 1:number_of_structure_atoms
        chain_id = _atom_layout_structure_identifier(
            structure_chain_ids[structure_atom_index],
            :label_asym_id,
            structure_atom_index,
        )

        sequence_id = _atom_layout_structure_identifier(
            structure_seq_ids[structure_atom_index],
            :label_seq_id,
            structure_atom_index,
        )

        atom_name = _atom_layout_atom_name(
            structure_atom_names[structure_atom_index],
            "Structure atom identifiers",
        )

        position = (
            _atom_layout_structure_coordinate(
                structure_x_coordinates[structure_atom_index],
                :Cartn_x,
                structure_atom_index,
            ),
            _atom_layout_structure_coordinate(
                structure_y_coordinates[structure_atom_index],
                :Cartn_y,
                structure_atom_index,
            ),
            _atom_layout_structure_coordinate(
                structure_z_coordinates[structure_atom_index],
                :Cartn_z,
                structure_atom_index,
            ),
        )

        key = (chain_id, sequence_id, atom_name)
        existing_position = get(atom_index, key, nothing)

        if existing_position !== nothing && existing_position != position
            throw(ArgumentError("Structure contains multiple coordinates for atom $key; select a single model and alternate conformation and use unambiguous residue identifiers"))
        end

        atom_index[key] = position
    end

    residue_cache = Dict{String,_AtomLayoutResidueData}()

    for token_index in 1:number_of_tokens
        residue_type = String(token_residue_types[token_index])
        chain_id = String(token_chain_ids[token_index])
        sequence_id = String(token_seq_ids[token_index])

        residue_data = get!(residue_cache, residue_type) do
            _atom_layout_residue_data(residue_type, ccd)
        end

        for slot_index in 1:NUM_ATOM_SLOTS
            residue_data.atom_mask[slot_index] || continue

            atom_name = residue_data.atom_names[slot_index]
            position = get(atom_index, (chain_id, sequence_id, atom_name), nothing)

            if position !== nothing
                positions[token_index, slot_index, 1] = position[1]
                positions[token_index, slot_index, 2] = position[2]
                positions[token_index, slot_index, 3] = position[3]
                mask[token_index, slot_index] = true
            end
        end
    end

    return positions, mask
end

dense_positions_from_structure(
    s::Structure,
    token_residue_types::AbstractVector{<:AbstractString},
    token_chain_ids::AbstractVector{<:AbstractString},
    token_seq_ids::AbstractVector{<:AbstractString},
    ccd,
)::Tuple{Array{Float32,3},Matrix{Bool}} = dense_positions_from_structure(
    s,
    token_residue_types,
    token_chain_ids,
    token_seq_ids;

)

function build_structure_from_dense_positions(;
    positions::AbstractArray{<:Real,3},
    mask::AbstractMatrix{Bool},
    token_residue_types::AbstractVector{<:AbstractString},
    token_chain_ids::AbstractVector{<:AbstractString},
    token_seq_ids::AbstractVector{<:AbstractString},
    bfactors::AbstractVector{<:Real},
    name::AbstractString = "predicted",
    ccd = nothing,
)::Structure
    number_of_position_tokens, number_of_slots =
        _atom_layout_validate_dense_arrays(positions, mask)

    number_of_tokens = _atom_layout_validate_tokens(
        token_residue_types,
        token_chain_ids,
        token_seq_ids,
    )

    Base.require_one_based_indexing(bfactors)

    number_of_position_tokens == number_of_tokens ||
        throw(DimensionMismatch("positions contains $number_of_position_tokens tokens, but token metadata contains $number_of_tokens"))

    number_of_slots <= NUM_ATOM_SLOTS ||
        throw(DimensionMismatch("positions contains $number_of_slots atom slots, exceeding NUM_ATOM_SLOTS=$NUM_ATOM_SLOTS"))

    length(bfactors) == number_of_tokens ||
        throw(DimensionMismatch("bfactors has $(length(bfactors)) entries, but token metadata contains $number_of_tokens"))

    all(isfinite, bfactors) ||
        throw(ArgumentError("bfactors must contain only finite values"))

    number_of_atoms = count(mask)

    if number_of_atoms == 0
        return Structure(
            String(name),
            StructureTable(),
            ChainInfo[],
            ResidueInfo[],
            Bond[],
        )
    end

    all_chain_ids = Vector{String}(undef, number_of_atoms)
    all_residue_ids = Vector{String}(undef, number_of_atoms)
    all_component_ids = Vector{String}(undef, number_of_atoms)
    all_atom_names = Vector{String}(undef, number_of_atoms)
    all_elements = Vector{String}(undef, number_of_atoms)
    all_positions = Matrix{Float32}(undef, number_of_atoms, 3)
    all_bfactors = Vector{Float32}(undef, number_of_atoms)
    residue_cache = Dict{String,_AtomLayoutResidueData}()
    atom_index = 0

    for token_index in 1:number_of_tokens
        any(view(mask, token_index, :)) || continue

        residue_type = String(token_residue_types[token_index])
        chain_id = String(token_chain_ids[token_index])
        sequence_id = String(token_seq_ids[token_index])
        bfactor_value = Float32(bfactors[token_index])

        residue_data = get!(residue_cache, residue_type) do
            _atom_layout_residue_data(residue_type, ccd)
        end

        for slot_index in 1:number_of_slots
            mask[token_index, slot_index] || continue

            residue_data.atom_mask[slot_index] ||
                throw(ArgumentError("mask selects invalid atom slot $slot_index for token $token_index with residue type $(repr(residue_type))"))

            atom_name = residue_data.atom_names[slot_index]
            element = residue_data.elements[slot_index]

            isempty(atom_name) &&
                throw(ArgumentError("mask selects an unnamed atom slot for token $token_index"))

            isempty(element) &&
                throw(ArgumentError("Element metadata is unavailable for atom $(repr(atom_name)) in residue $(repr(residue_type)); provide complete CCD element symbols"))

            x_coordinate = Float32(positions[token_index, slot_index, 1])
            y_coordinate = Float32(positions[token_index, slot_index, 2])
            z_coordinate = Float32(positions[token_index, slot_index, 3])

            if !(isfinite(x_coordinate) &&
                 isfinite(y_coordinate) &&
                 isfinite(z_coordinate))
                throw(ArgumentError("positions contains nonfinite coordinates for token $token_index at atom slot $slot_index"))
            end

            atom_index += 1
            all_chain_ids[atom_index] = chain_id
            all_residue_ids[atom_index] = sequence_id
            all_component_ids[atom_index] = residue_type
            all_atom_names[atom_index] = atom_name
            all_elements[atom_index] = element
            all_positions[atom_index, 1] = x_coordinate
            all_positions[atom_index, 2] = y_coordinate
            all_positions[atom_index, 3] = z_coordinate
            all_bfactors[atom_index] = bfactor_value
        end
    end

    return structure_from_arrays(;
        name = String(name),
        chain_ids = all_chain_ids,
        res_ids = all_residue_ids,
        comp_ids = all_component_ids,
        atom_names = all_atom_names,
        elements = all_elements,
        positions = all_positions,
        bfactors = all_bfactors,
    )
end

The weak parts in my previous answer were mostly about **certainty**, **deduplication**, and **scope**. I had several valid concerns, but I mixed definite defects with context-dependent risks and I repeated the same core issue in too many fragments.

## Critique

1. I overstated some items as definite “errors” when they were really context-dependent design or data-model risks. That was too absolute for an audit that only had a code snippet and not the surrounding module, types, data contracts, or tests.

2. I failed to separate “this snippet cannot run standalone” from “this is a bug in the real codebase.” Undefined names such as `STANDARD_ATOM_MASK`, `ATOM_ORDER`, `NUM_ATOM_SLOTS`, `Structure`, and related APIs are a hard failure only if this exact snippet is supposed to be self-contained.

3. I did not explicitly rule out syntax concerns that are actually valid Julia. Keyword arguments introduced with a semicolon are standard Julia function syntax, and return-type annotations like `function f(...)::T` are also valid Julia syntax.[1][2]

4. I also should have stated clearly that the `struct` field annotations in `_AtomLayoutResidueData` are normal Julia composite-type syntax, so there was no basis to imply a syntax problem there.[2]

5. I fragmented one main defect into too many separate bullets. The under-specified structure atom key should have been presented as one consolidated issue with subcases: residue type, insertion code, altloc, and model identity are all aspects of the same flawed key design.

6. Several performance criticisms were weaker than the correctness criticisms because they were reasoned, not measured. They may still be good review notes, but they should not have been presented with the same confidence as direct logic defects.

7. I included some API-design complaints, such as the misleading name `first_element_char`, that are real quality issues but lower-severity than silent data corruption risks. They should have been ranked lower.

## Corrected version

1. **Most certain defect:** `dense_positions_from_structure` indexes structure atoms by `(chain_id, sequence_id, atom_name)`, which is not a sufficiently unique residue/atom identity. If distinct atoms share those three values across residue-type ambiguities, insertion-code differences, alternate locations, or multiple models, the mapping can collide, overwrite, or throw false duplicate errors.

2. **Silent overwrite defect:** in that same dictionary, duplicate keys with identical coordinates are silently accepted and the later entry overwrites the earlier one. That suppresses duplicate-input detection and can hide malformed or redundant structure rows.

3. **Cross-residue mismatch defect:** the structure-side atom index does not include residue/component identity, but token reconstruction depends on residue-specific atom layouts. That means token lookup can succeed against the wrong physical residue when chain/sequence/atom-name values align.

4. **Normalization inconsistency:** residue types, chain IDs, and sequence IDs are not normalized consistently across all paths. Some values are only converted with `String(...)`, while atom names and some inference paths use `strip(...)`, so logically identical identifiers can fail to match because of padding or formatting differences.

5. **Element inference fallback is unsafe as a silent fallback:** when CCD element metadata is incomplete or absent, the code falls back to heuristic inference from atom names. For standardized data that may work often, but in a strict auditor sense it is a correctness risk because wrong element assignment can pass through without a hard failure.

6. **Mixed-authority metadata defect:** `_atom_layout_residue_data` uses authoritative CCD element symbols when present and heuristic inference when absent, inside the same residue. That creates partially trusted outputs without marking which atoms were inferred versus sourced.

7. **Lossy numeric conversion:** coordinates are aggressively narrowed to `Float32` during parsing, flattening, reconstruction, and structure rebuilding. That makes the conversion path non-round-trippable for higher-precision inputs and can introduce avoidable coordinate drift.

8. **String-coordinate parsing is narrower than necessary:** `_atom_layout_structure_coordinate` parses string coordinates directly to `Float32` instead of validating at higher precision and narrowing later. That increases the chance of premature precision loss or parsing edge-case behavior.

9. **Round-trip inconsistency:** `atom_layout_to_flat` always returns a `flat_mask` that is entirely `true`, so the second return value carries no real state. That is weak API design at best and misleading at worst because it suggests meaningful mask information that does not actually exist.

10. **Constructor-path inconsistency:** `build_structure_from_dense_positions` returns `Structure(...)` directly for the empty case and `structure_from_arrays(...)` for the non-empty case. Unless both constructors are guaranteed to enforce identical invariants and metadata conventions, the API can yield structurally inconsistent results depending only on atom count.

11. **Layout truncation risk:** `build_structure_from_dense_positions` only checks that `number_of_slots <= NUM_ATOM_SLOTS`; it does not verify that the provided layout width is sufficient for each residue being rebuilt. A caller can therefore pass a too-narrow layout and silently drop valid higher-index atom slots by leaving them unrepresentable.

12. **Lookup-order fragility:** `_atom_layout_lookup` prefers property access before several other lookup strategies. On hybrid container/object types that expose both properties and key-based data, the function can return a property value when the intended source was associative data.
